name: @kreiseck/kasseneck-api
description: JavaScript-Zwilling von kasseneck_api (Flutter) fuer das Kasseneck-Backend
author: Kreiseck

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))" && node scripts/check-build-exports.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && TZ=Europe/Vienna node --test $(find test-dist -name '*.test.js') && TZ=UTC node --test $(find test-dist -name '*.test.js') && TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati node --test $(find test-dist -name '*.test.js')
